---
title: "Citations of Retracted ICPSR Papers"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(parallel)
library(lubridate)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# setwd(...)

# load data
merged <- read_csv("merged.csv")
refs <- read_csv("citations/refs_merged.csv")
```

Number of citations:

```{r}
# number of citations per paper
refs |> group_by(filepath) |> count()

# add retraction years to refs
refs$ret.year <- numeric(length = nrow(refs))
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "ECigUse")] <- merged$RetractionYear[5]
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "HowDidTheyDecide")] <- merged$RetractionYear[6]
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "HypertensionGuidelines")] <- merged$RetractionYear[9]
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "MarijuanaUse")] <- merged$RetractionYear[7]
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "NonmetroRole")] <- merged$RetractionYear[2]
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "SchoolSocialBonds")] <- merged$RetractionYear[3]
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "SuicideNatDisasters")] <- merged$RetractionYear[4]
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "TurningIn")] <- merged$RetractionYear[8]
refs$ret.year[which(refs$filepath == "WorldsApart")] <- merged$RetractionYear[1]

# number of citations per paper by year
refsbyyear <- refs |> group_by(filepath, year, ret.year) |>
  summarise(num_citations = n())
(head(refsbyyear, 20))
```


Plots of citations by year. Retraction Year in red.
```{r}
# plot citations by year
refsbyyear |> 
  group_by(filepath) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = num_citations)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = ret.year), colour = "red") +
    xlim(1990, 2030) +
    ylim(0, 50) +
    facet_wrap(~filepath)

```

Summary table - number of citations before and after retraction year:

```{r}
refsbyyear |> group_by(filepath, year <= ret.year) |>
  count()
```

Flag whether a retracted article was cited the same year it was retracted:

```{r}
# create flag
refs <- refs |> mutate(ref.same.year = (year == ret.year))

# number citing papers retracted during the publication year
refs |> group_by(ref.same.year) |> summarise(n())

# number with available publication date
refs |> group_by(ref.same.year, !is.na(pub.date)) |> summarise(n())
```
